Final notebook to have the figure from the report


```{r include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(arrow)
library(lubridate)
library(estimatr)
library(stargazer)

Sys.setenv(lang = "en_US")
```



```{r}
save_path_entsoe_output <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_instrumnet_motivation/ENTSOE/outputs/final'
setwd(save_path_entsoe_output)

first_stage_data <- read_parquet('first_stage_data.parquet') %>% 
  filter(auction_after != 7)

capacity_fields <- c("Published.Unavailable.Capacity"          
,"Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ,  "Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity"        
, "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", "gen_tot")

#adjuster l'ordre de grandeur des indispos pour ne pas avoir des coefficients nuls
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data%>%
  filter(is.finite(log_price_diff) & 
           is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))%>% 
   mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000))

first_stage_data_clean_pre_2021 <- first_stage_data_clean %>% 
  filter(datetime < '2021-01-01')
 
first_stage_data_clean_post_2021 <- first_stage_data_clean %>% 
  filter(datetime >= '2021-01-01')

```



Complete models that include plant unavailabilities as well as the renewable based instrument
```{r}
non_finite_rows <- first_stage_data %>%
  filter(!is.finite(log_price_diff) | !is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))

print(nrow(non_finite_rows))

print(nrow(first_stage_data_clean_post_2021))
class(first_stage_data_clean_post_2021$creneau)
colnames(first_stage_data)

nrow(first_stage_data_clean_post_2021 %>% 
       filter(Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share >0))

```
Estimation after 2021 the REMIT publication policy

```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_basic_post <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Share + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share  + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)

# dummy for creneau

m_creneau_post <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Share + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share  + gen_tot + as.factor(creneau) ,
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)

# use controls
# put a dummy for the number of the auction
# put a dummy for the creneau

# warning cannot put a dummy for date + creneau + auction
# full determination, no variation
m_control_post <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Share + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share + gen_tot +
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)

```

Interpretation
for the basic model,
for a given unavailability of 1 percentage point,
the electricity price increases by 0.9 %



```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic_post, m_creneau_post, m_control_post, 
    type = "text",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Timeslot FE", 'Timeslot + Auction FE'),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Share', "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share", 'gen_tot')
 )
```

Estimation using the unpublished info that the market didn't have access to

```{r}

m_basic_unpublished <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Unpublished.Unavailable.Share + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share  + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_data_clean)

m_creneau_unpublished <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Unpublished.Unavailable.Share + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share  + gen_tot +
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)

m_control_unpublished <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Unpublished.Unavailable.Share + Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share  + gen_tot +
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
```
